# AR Plastic Surgery

> AR Plastic Surgery is a plastic, cosmetic, hand and microvascular surgery clinic in Karimnagar, Telangana, India, led by Dr Ashok Reddy (MBBS, DNB Mumbai, M.Ch Delhi, Gold Medalist) — Plastic, Cosmetic, Hair Transplant, Hand & Microvascular Surgeon. Tagline: "Precision and Perfection". Open Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Address: Opp. Reddy Gari Vantillu, Court Chowrasta, Karimnagar, Telangana 505001. Phone: +91 91826 56866. Consultations are by appointment; treatment costs are confirmed at consultation after examination.

## Hair restoration

- [FUE Hair Transplant](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/fue-hair-transplant.html): follicular unit extraction hair transplantation for male and female pattern hair loss.
- [PRP Therapy](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/prp-therapy.html): platelet-rich plasma therapy for hair loss and skin rejuvenation.

## Face

- [Rhinoplasty](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/rhinoplasty.html): nose reshaping surgery (cosmetic and functional).
- [Facelift](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/facelift.html): surgical facial rejuvenation.
- [Eyelid Surgery (Blepharoplasty)](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/eyelid-surgery-blepharoplasty.html): upper and lower eyelid surgery.
- [Botox Treatment](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/botox-treatment.html): botulinum toxin injections for wrinkles.
- [Dermal Fillers](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/dermal-fillers.html): injectable facial fillers.
- [Chemical Peels](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/chemical-peels.html): medical skin peels for pigmentation and skin texture.
- [Laser Treatments](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/laser-treatments.html): laser skin and hair treatments.

## Hand and microvascular surgery

- [Hand Surgeon in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/hand-surgeon-karimnagar.html): hand surgery services, injuries and conditions treated.
- [Hand Trauma Surgery](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/hand-trauma-surgery.html): treatment of hand injuries and fractures.
- [Tendon Repair](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/tendon-repair.html): flexor and extensor tendon repair.
- [Nerve Repair & Microsurgery](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/nerve-repair-microsurgery.html): peripheral nerve repair under magnification.
- [Carpal Tunnel Release](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/carpal-tunnel-release.html): surgery for carpal tunnel syndrome.
- [Fingertip Replantation](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/fingertip-replantation.html): replantation of amputated fingertips and digits.
- [Microsurgery & Free Flap](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/procedures/microsurgery-free-flap.html): free tissue transfer and microvascular reconstruction.

## Treatment cost guides (Karimnagar)

- [Hair Transplant Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/hair-transplant-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹40,000–₹1,50,000+ depending on graft count (about ₹35–₹60 per graft).
- [Gynecomastia Surgery Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/gynecomastia-surgery-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹60,000–₹1,20,000.
- [Rhinoplasty Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/rhinoplasty-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹80,000–₹1,80,000.
- [Breast Augmentation Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/breast-augmentation-cost-karimnagar.html): cost is confirmed at consultation after examination; no fixed published price.
- [Tummy Tuck Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/tummy-tuck-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹1,00,000–₹2,50,000.
- [Botox Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/botox-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹8,000–₹20,000 per area.
- [PRP Therapy Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/prp-therapy-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹5,000–₹12,000 per session.
- [Lipoma Removal Cost in Karimnagar](https://surgery.arplasticsurgery.co.in/blog/lipoma-removal-cost-karimnagar.html): typically ₹15,000–₹40,000.
